```{python}
#| echo: false
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from matplotlib import font_manager

def get_chinese_font():
    font_files = [
        Path(r"C:/Windows/Fonts/NotoSansSC-VF.ttf"),
        Path(r"C:/Windows/Fonts/simhei.ttf"),
        Path(r"C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc"),
        Path("/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"),
        Path("/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Bold.ttc"),
        Path("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"),
        Path("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/arphic/ukai.ttc"),
    ]
    for font_file in font_files:
        if font_file.exists():
            font_manager.fontManager.addfont(str(font_file))
            return font_manager.FontProperties(fname=str(font_file))

    fallback_names = [
        "Noto Sans CJK SC",
        "Noto Sans SC",
        "SimHei",
        "Microsoft YaHei",
        "DengXian",
        "Arial Unicode MS",
    ]
    available_fonts = {font.name for font in font_manager.fontManager.ttflist}
    for font_name in fallback_names:
        if font_name in available_fonts:
            return font_manager.FontProperties(family=font_name)
    return font_manager.FontProperties()


chinese_font = get_chinese_font()
font_candidates = [
    chinese_font.get_name(),
    "Noto Sans CJK SC",
    "Noto Sans SC",
    "SimHei",
    "Microsoft YaHei",
    "DengXian",
    "Arial Unicode MS",
]
matplotlib.rcParams["font.family"] = "sans-serif"
matplotlib.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = font_candidates
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False


def apply_chinese_font(ax):
    ax.title.set_fontproperties(chinese_font)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_fontproperties(chinese_font)
    ax.yaxis.label.set_fontproperties(chinese_font)
    for label in ax.get_xticklabels() + ax.get_yticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(chinese_font)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data_path = Path("data") / "weekly_data.json"
summary_path = Path("data") / "ai_summary.txt"

with open(data_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    weekly_data = json.load(f)

with open(summary_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    ai_summary = f.read().strip()

index_rows = []
for name, value in weekly_data.items():
    if isinstance(value, dict) and "change_pct" in value:
        index_rows.append({
            "指数": name,
            "收盘价": value.get("close"),
            "周涨跌幅(%)": value.get("change_pct"),
            "日期": value.get("date", ""),
            "数据来源": value.get("source", "akshare / yfinance"),
        })

index_df = pd.DataFrame(index_rows)
if not index_df.empty:
    index_df["收盘价"] = index_df["收盘价"].map(lambda x: f"{float(x):,.2f}" if pd.notna(x) else "")
    index_df["周涨跌幅(%)"] = index_df["周涨跌幅(%)"].map(lambda x: f"{float(x):.2f}" if pd.notna(x) else "")

sector_df = pd.DataFrame(weekly_data.get("sectors", []))
if not sector_df.empty:
    sector_df = sector_df.rename(columns={
        "rank": "排名",
        "name": "行业",
        "change_pct": "周涨跌幅(%)",
        "source": "数据来源",
    })
    sector_df["周涨跌幅(%)"] = pd.to_numeric(sector_df["周涨跌幅(%)"], errors="coerce")
```

# A 股与美股指数对比

```{python}
#| echo: false
plot_df = pd.DataFrame(index_rows)
if plot_df.empty:
    display(Markdown("主要指数数据暂未获取成功。"))
else:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    colors = ["#c0392b" if v >= 0 else "#27ae60" for v in plot_df["周涨跌幅(%)"]]
    ax.bar(plot_df["指数"], plot_df["周涨跌幅(%)"], color=colors)
    ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.6)
    ax.set_title("主要指数周涨跌幅对比", fontproperties=chinese_font)
    ax.set_ylabel("周涨跌幅（%）", fontproperties=chinese_font)
    ax.set_xlabel("指数", fontproperties=chinese_font)
    apply_chinese_font(ax)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

# 行业热点

```{python}
#| echo: false
if sector_df.empty:
    display(Markdown("行业数据暂未获取成功。"))
else:
    display(sector_df[["排名", "行业", "周涨跌幅(%)", "数据来源"]])

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))
    chart_df = sector_df.head(8).copy()
    colors = ["#c0392b" if v >= 0 else "#27ae60" for v in chart_df["周涨跌幅(%)"]]
    ax.barh(chart_df["行业"], chart_df["周涨跌幅(%)"], color=colors)
    ax.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.6)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_title("本周行业涨跌幅排名（%）", fontproperties=chinese_font)
    ax.set_xlabel("涨跌幅（%）", fontproperties=chinese_font)
    apply_chinese_font(ax)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

# 结果解读与局限

本报告由脚本自动读取市场数据并生成摘要，适合作为课程项目中的自动化周报原型。当前数据接口可能受网络、访问频率、字段变动等因素影响，脚本已记录接口异常和备用接口使用情况。若行业或指数数据缺失，报告会保留可用数据并在文本中说明。

AI 摘要基于 `data/weekly_data.json` 中已有字段生成，主要用于概括市场表现和形成周报文字，不构成任何投资建议。实际应用中还需要进一步考虑数据授权、模型输出稳定性、金融合规要求和人工校验流程。

```{python}
    "- A 股指数数据：akshare",
```
